title: Balanced scalar extension for arbitrary rings and module sheaves
statement: Let $R,S$ be rings, not necessarily commutative, and $f:R\to S$ a unital ring homomorphism. For a left $R$-module $M$, define $S\otimes_R M$ to be the value on $M$ of the left adjoint to restriction of scalars along $f$; equivalently it is the left $S$-module generated by symbols $[m]$ modulo $[m+n]=[m]+[n]$ and $[rm]=f(r)[m]$. The pure tensor $s\otimes m$ means $s[m]$. This defines a functor on left modules. The canonical composite comparison $(T\otimes_S -)\circ(S\otimes_R -)\cong T\otimes_R -$ is the unique comparison of left adjoints to the composite restriction. On a site with sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], define scalar extension of a sheaf of left $R$-modules as the sheafification of its sectionwise scalar-extension presheaf, with restrictions induced by the scalar-extension functor.
